scenes.text: Imagine being the only tree for two hundred and fifty miles in every direction.
For decades, it was a living landmark for travelers, surviving extreme heat because its roots reached over a hundred feet underground.
A truck driver, allegedly drunk, managed to drive across hundreds of miles of empty sand and crash directly into this single tree.
Today, a metal pole stands in its place, but the ultimate mystery remains: how do you hit the only obstacle in an entire desert?
